How Spotly Works

Spotly helps you discover trusted workers, businesses, and service providers near you in just a few steps.

Search by location
Select your State, Local Government, Town, or Area to discover providers near you.

Contact directly

5
Save and follow
Save providers and follow your favorites to receive updates and notifications.

Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about Spotly.

What is Spotly?
Spotly is a platform that connects users with trusted workers and businesses nearby.
Is Spotly free to use?
Yes. Searching and contacting providers is completely free.
What is a "Verified ID" badge?
It shows a provider has submitted valid government-issued identification (ID + selfie) that Spotly's team has reviewed and approved. It confirms identity only — not the quality of their work.
How do I get a "Verified ID" badge?
Go to your Provider Dashboard → Verify ID (Verification Center), then upload a clear photo of your government-issued ID and a selfie, and submit. Spotly's admin team reviews it and updates your status within 24–48 hours.
I can't see the "Verified ID badge" option in settings. Why?
This option only appears for registered providers. If you're a customer account, you won't see it — verification is provider-only. If you are a provider and still don't see it, log out and back in, or make sure your provider profile setup is complete.
What should I do to pass KYC verification?
Upload a valid, unexpired government-issued ID with a clear, unedited photo. Upload a well-lit selfie of yourself with your face clearly visible, matching your ID. Make sure both images aren't blurry and nothing is cropped out.
How long is this badge valid?
Once approved, the Verified ID badge stays active on your profile and doesn't expire on its own. Spotly can revoke it if documents are later found to be invalid or fraudulent.
I submitted my ID and selfie, but I didn't get a badge. What should I do?
Reviews take 24–48 hours. If it's been longer, check your Verification Center for a rejection reason, such as a blurry photo or a selfie that doesn't match your ID, and resubmit after correcting it. If it's still unresolved, contact Spotly support.
What is a Premium badge?
It shows a provider is on Spotly's paid Premium Plan (₦2,000/month), which boosts visibility in search results and on the map, and unlocks extra features like video portfolio uploads.
How do I get a premium badge?
From your Provider Dashboard, tap "Upgrade to Premium — ₦2,000/month" and complete payment. Your badge and expiry date update immediately after payment is confirmed.
What are the prohibited activities on Spotly?
1. Impersonating other users or providers
2. Uploading illegal or harmful content
3. Committing fraud or misrepresentation
4. Harassing other users
5. Manipulating ratings or creating fake reviews
Should I chat or call the provider?
Spotly doesn't have in-app chat. You contact providers directly by Call or WhatsApp from their profile, with no middleman.
How long will my premium ads stay on Spotly?
Your Premium Plan runs for 30 days from payment and expires automatically at the end of that period unless renewed.
How do I renew my Spotly Premium Plan?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Upgrade to Premium. Complete your payment before or after your current plan expires to extend your Premium subscription by another 30 days.
How often can I renew my Premium Plan?
As often as you like. You can renew any time, even before the current cycle ends.
What if my Premium Plan is closed?
Your profile drops back to the Free plan. You lose the Premium badge, priority placement, and video portfolio access, but your listing stays active and reachable.
How to leave a review about the provider?
Open the provider's profile, tap the review/rating option, choose a star rating, and write your feedback. Only one review per provider per device is allowed.
How to search a provider on Spotly?
Use the search bar on the home or search screen and type a service, name, or category. You can also switch to Map mode to browse providers near you.
How do I share my photos on the Market page?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Photos. Upload photos from your device, add an optional caption and hashtags, then tap Post to Market. Your uploaded photos are also added to your public profile. Free plan allows up to 3 photos, while Premium allows up to 10.
How do I share my videos on the Market page?
This is a Premium-only feature. Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Video. Paste a YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram video link, add a title/caption, and publish it to the Market. You can upload up to 3 portfolio videos and have up to 3 videos live on the Market at once.
How long do my Market posts stay visible?
Free Plan: photo posts stay live for 7 days, then expire automatically. No video posts allowed. Premium Plan: both photo and video posts stay live for 30 days, then expire automatically unless reposted, with up to 10 photo slots and 3 video slots at once.
How do I find a provider's business location on the map?
Open a provider's post on the Market and tap "Location," or go to Maps from the bottom nav and select a provider to open a full map with their live pin. Tap "Open in Google Maps" or "Get Directions" to navigate.
How do I view my business location on the map?
Go to Dashboard → My Profile and tap "View my business on Map" to preview your pin exactly as customers see it. If no location is set, tap "Update Business Location" to add one.
How do I share my business location with customers?
In your Provider Dashboard, find the location preview section and tap "Share Location" to open your device's share sheet (or WhatsApp) with a Google Maps directions link plus your Spotly profile link. Or tap "Copy Link" to copy the location link directly.
How do customers get directions to my business?
From your profile or a Market post, they tap "Open in Google Maps" or "Get Directions" for instant turn-by-turn navigation to your pin.
How do I share my business profile?
Go to Dashboard → Share Profile and tap "Share" to open your device's native share sheet (or WhatsApp) with your profile link.
How do I update my business profile?
Go to Dashboard → My Profile and edit your bio, occupation, and location directly, then save. To change your name or phone number, contact Spotly support.
How do I upload photos to my profile?
Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Photos. Choose images from your device and upload them. Your photos will automatically appear on your public profile. Free plan allows up to 3 photos, while Premium allows up to 10.
How do I upload videos to my profile?
This is a Premium-only feature. Tap the + (Create) button on the Home page and select Add Video. Paste a YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram video link, add a title and description, then save. You can upload up to 3 videos, which will appear on your public profile and can also be shared to the Market.
How do I contact Spotly?
Open the menu → Contact Us, fill in your name, subject (Complaint, Account Issue, Payment Issue, Provider Issue, General Inquiry, Business Enquiry), and message, then tap "Send Message." Spotly aims to respond within 24 hours on business days.
How do I report a problem or bug?
Go to Contact Us, select the closest matching subject (e.g. Account Issue), describe the bug clearly, and submit. Use this also for suspicious activity, fake profiles, or harmful content.

Safety Tips

Your safety is our priority.

Review provider profiles carefully.
Read ratings and customer reviews.
Meet in safe locations when possible.
Avoid making full payments before work begins.
Ask for receipts or written agreements.
Report suspicious behavior to Spotly.
Verify identity documents when necessary.
Keep communication within trusted channels.
Emergency Notice
If you feel unsafe or suspect fraud, stop the transaction immediately and contact local authorities.

About Spotly

Connecting communities with trusted skilled workers and businesses.

Our Story

Spotly was created with one simple mission: to help people easily discover skilled workers and businesses around them.

Every day, millions of talented workers struggle to find customers, while customers struggle to find trusted service providers nearby. We believed there should be a better way.

Instead of endless scrolling through entertainment content, Spotly was built as a platform that helps people discover real skills, real businesses, and real opportunities in their local communities.

Our Community

We serve plumbers, tailors, mechanics, electricians, hairdressers, builders, farmers, designers, artisans, caterers, photographers, barbers, bakers, and any person with a skill or service to offer.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us.

Last Updated: June 2026

Information We Collect

  • Name and phone number
  • Email address (if provided)
  • Business information and occupation
  • Location information (town, LGA, state, area)
  • Uploaded photos and videos
  • Identity verification documents

How We Use Your Information

  • Create and manage your account
  • Display your business profile to potential customers
  • Improve our platform and services
  • Verify provider identities
  • Communicate important updates
  • Prevent fraud and abuse

Location Information

Spotly uses your location to show nearby providers, display providers on maps, and improve search results. Location data is used only for platform functionality.

Photos and Videos

Photos and videos uploaded by providers may be displayed publicly on their profile and within Spotly features. You control what you upload.

Identity Verification

Verification documents are used solely for identity verification and are never publicly displayed. They are reviewed by the Spotly team only.

Third-Party Services

  • Google Maps — for location and mapping features
  • Google Drive — for photo and document storage
  • Flutterwave — for payment processing
  • Notification providers for alerts

Cookies and Local Storage

We use cookies and local storage to improve performance, save your location preferences, and speed up loading times. No advertising cookies are used.

Data Protection

We use reasonable security measures to protect your information. Your data is never sold to third parties or used for advertising purposes.

Your Rights

  • Update your profile information at any time
  • Request account deletion by contacting us
  • Ask questions about how your data is used

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@spotly.ng

By using Spotly, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
Spotly Privacy Policy · June 2026

Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before using Spotly.

Last Updated: June 2026

1. Platform Purpose

Spotly is a discovery platform that connects customers with skilled workers and businesses. Spotly acts as an intermediary and is not a party to any service agreement between users and providers.

2. User Responsibilities

  • Provide accurate and honest information
  • Communicate respectfully with providers
  • Make informed decisions based on profiles and reviews
  • Not misuse the platform for any illegal purpose

3. Provider Responsibilities

  • Provide accurate business information
  • Avoid misleading or deceiving customers
  • Treat customers and other users respectfully
  • Maintain lawful business practices

4. Identity Verification

Verification confirms that a provider has submitted identification documents reviewed by Spotly. It does not guarantee service quality or outcomes. Customers are encouraged to conduct their own due diligence.

5. Premium Subscription

  • Premium subscriptions improve provider visibility in search and maps
  • Subscriptions are time-based and expire automatically
  • Subscriptions can be renewed at any time
  • Fees paid are generally non-refundable except where required by law

6. Reviews and Ratings

Users may leave honest reviews based on their genuine experience. Spotly reserves the right to remove fake, abusive, or spam reviews. Only one review per provider per device is permitted.

7. Prohibited Activities

  • Impersonating other users or providers
  • Uploading illegal or harmful content
  • Committing fraud or misrepresentation
  • Harassing other users
  • Manipulating ratings or creating fake reviews

8. Limitation of Liability

Spotly is a discovery platform and is not responsible for any agreements, payments, disputes, or outcomes arising between users and providers. Users engage with providers at their own discretion.

9. Service Changes

Spotly may update, modify, or discontinue features at any time. We will notify users of significant changes where possible.

10. Account Suspension

Spotly may suspend or remove accounts that violate these Terms and Conditions, without prior notice in serious cases.

By using Spotly, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.
Spotly Terms & Conditions · June 2026

Community Guidelines

To keep Spotly safe, honest, and trustworthy for everyone.

Be Respectful

Treat all users, providers, and agents with professionalism and courtesy. Harassment, insults, or abusive language will not be tolerated.

Be Honest

Use real, accurate information about yourself and your business. Misleading profiles harm the community and will be removed.

No Spam

Do not send unwanted messages, post irrelevant content, or create misleading listings. Spam accounts will be permanently removed.

No Fraud

Fraudulent accounts, fake identities, and deceptive practices are strictly prohibited. Such accounts will be permanently removed and reported.

Respect Reviews

Do not manipulate ratings or create fake reviews. Reviews must be based on genuine experiences. Only one review per provider is allowed per device.

Upload Appropriate Content

Photos and videos must relate to your business or skills. Offensive, explicit, or unrelated content will be removed immediately.

Protect Your Community

If you notice suspicious activity, fake profiles, or harmful content, report it to Spotly at support@spotly.ng

Together, we build trust.
We can build a trusted marketplace for skilled workers and businesses everywhere.
Spotly Community Guidelines · June 2026
